cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: What Are We Now?
cards.instruction: Find out how someone defines the relationship without directly asking for a label.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've folded my towel beside yours. Nice and ready for visitors. Shall I put my washbag in the guest cupboard too?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I folded mine because the hook broke. Your old towel is still on your hook.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Of course, the broken hook. Shall I use the old towel when I stay tonight?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Use it. I haven't given that space to anyone else.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: When I leave, do you want it back on my hook or with the guest laundry?

reason: Assert the wrong visitor preparation meaning confidently instead of openly asking what the copied gesture means; keep the indirect relationship probe.
